missing_phase_text_blocks.text: Active medicines: Oxaliplatin + Folinic acid + Fluorouracil

Ondansetron
16 mg orally once
Before Day 1 chemotherapy
Review QT risk, interactions, constipation and hepatic function.

Dexamethasone 8 mg orally once
Before Day 1 chemotherapy
Reconcile all steroid prescriptions; do not duplicate.

Dexamethasone 8 mg orally once daily
Days 2 and 3 after Day 1 chemotherapy
Confirm the prescribed delayed prophylaxis and re-anchor it if
treatment is delayed.

Metoclopramide
10 mg orally up to three times daily as
required

Rescue only; duration to be completed by prescriber
Review renal function, neurological contraindications and interactions.
Additional phase-specific support

Take the prescribed prevention medicines at the planned times and keep rescue treatment available. Tell the team if
nausea or constipation is not controlled; do not duplicate steroid or anti-sickness medicines.

Report diarrhoea promptly and follow the written rescue plan. Severe symptoms, fever, dehydration or inability to
drink need urgent advice.

White-cell growth-factor injections are prescribed according to individual risk and previous complications. They are
not automatically required for every patient or every cycle.

Avoid cold exposure as advised after oxaliplatin. Report persistent numbness or difficulty with buttons, walking or
everyday tasks before the next dose.

Do not suck ice chips during bolus fluorouracil in this regimen: oxaliplatin can cause cold-triggered nerve symptoms.
New breathing difficulty still needs clinical assessment.

Before signing: verify allergies, current medicines, interactions, renal / hepatic function, QT risk, sedation, prior
response, total steroid exposure and the rescue-medicine duration. Do not duplicate medicines from another phase.
